hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean modern UI chrome (Inter font, Tableau10 palette, well-spaced controls) but the 900×900 SVG is cropped in the viewport so the circle pack is cut off, and the bundled dark edges over filled circles create visual noise without sufficient contrast to read cleanly as a distinct layer.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout circle sizes, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, key functions present on data joins, and no truncated baselines or dual-axis fabrication; the sunburst's sqrt radial scale slightly distorts area proportionality but is a standard readability tradeoff.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire full 1500ms layout re-transitions on every input event with no debounce, and no .interrupt() is called on nodeSelection before new transitions begin, leaving current_x/y at stale intermediate values when layouts are switched mid-flight.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout avoids working memory overload and the circle pack hierarchy is legible, but 300 bundled edges converge into a tangled dark mass that obscures the node structure in the default view, and the dense control surface (8 layout buttons, tension slider, 3 toggles, easing select, FPS display) adds cognitive overhead before the viewer can engage with the data.
